benefit_text: Farmers get financial assistance of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every four months.
who_can_apply: Any farmer family that owns cultivable land in its name can apply. There is no age limit and no income limit mentioned in the scheme.
documents: Aadhaar Card, landholding papers, savings bank account statement.
how_to_apply: Visit the PM‑Kisan portal online. Choose New Farmer Registration, enter your Aadhaar and mobile number, verify with OTP, fill the details, upload the required documents and submit.
